input: A unit may commit an order of the form "attack <E>" only if <E> equals the value of /world/focus.text, the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, so that all three units shoot the same target and none walks out alone toward a different enemy.
response: always([+modifies(/orders/$k.text) +text_contains(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+modifies(/orders/$k.text) +text_contains(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+modifies(/orders/$k.text) +text_contains(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
